news.title: When AI’s architects ask to slow down, education must speak up
news.summary_en: When the people building the world’s most powerful artificial intelligence systems warn that their creations are advancing too quickly, the rest of society should stop and listen.

news.title: Stop trying to AI-proof your assignments
news.summary_en: A few years ago, many of us in higher education were asking a fairly straightforward question about AI: How do we stop students from using it to do their work? I was asking a different question.
